verdict.rationale: Public status lookup for filings or cases is a fair question for a state filing office, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials) on www.nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov. None of it documents whether the office offers a status-lookup page, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
